The initiative

From an idea to something useful.

I founded STEM GEARS, a small educational venture producing 3D-printed cutaway aircraft-engine models and STEM kits. By translating internal engine structures into tangible, inspectable learning tools, the venture makes mechanics and propulsion more accessible to younger students.

10Product models
60Products sold
VND 100mRevenue, fully donated
01

Design for understanding

I developed ten distinct product models, exposing internal aircraft-engine structures for hands-on STEM learning.

02

Bring the models to learners

The venture sold 60 educational products and generated VND 100 million in revenue.

03

Connect enterprise with service

The full VND 100 million in revenue was donated to Creativism Club and SafeFlow Vietnam, supporting community-focused initiatives.
